title: Netherlands: Dutch Economy Walks a Tightrope Between Resilience and Household Strain · 19 Aug
keywords: Netherlands, Dutch economy, inflation, purchasing power, cost of living, De Nederlandsche Bank, Eurostat, cyber resilience, critical infrastructure, NIS2, Dutch politics, eurozone, energy prices, household finances, economic outlook
notes: The Netherlands is navigating a delicate balancing act: official data points to a still-expanding economy, yet households continue to feel the weight of elevated prices and weakening purchasing power. Two parallel policy debates — over cost-of-living pressures and new cyber-resilience legislation — are reshaping the domestic political landscape and testing public confidence in the government's management of compounding crises.
